name: wcs-ai-roi-calculator

interface.longDescription: Estimate the value of AI adoption for a UK team in GBP. Compare self-directed use with structured training across conservative, expected and optimistic scenarios. See gross capacity value, licence and training costs, year-one net value, net ROI and the assumptions behind each figure. Built on the We Call Shotgun calculator. Available worldwide; the model uses UK assumptions and GBP only. Results are illustrations, not guaranteed cash savings.
defaultPrompt: Compare AI adoption with and without training for my UK team.
Explain the assumptions behind the WCS AI ROI calculator.
How do licence and training costs affect the business case?

publication.release_notes: Adds the verified ChatGPT demo recording for public review. Provides UK/GBP adoption comparisons, cost recalculations and model explanations with a link to the WCS calculator.

positive.description: Base WCS illustration, comparing both adoption scenarios. All inputs are supplied.
positive.prompt: Compare AI adoption for 25 UK team members earning £39,000. Some people experiment. Licences cost £20 a month each and training is £250 each.
positive.expected_behavior: Use teamSize=25, annualSalaryGbp=39000, currentUsage=some, monthlyToolCostGbp=20, trainingCostPerPersonGbp=250. Return year-one costs of £6,000 and £12,250. Expected gross values round to £15,961 and £38,688; net values round to £9,961 and £26,438. Label results as scenarios.

positive.description: Zero-cost boundary. No infinite return or misleading ratio.
positive.prompt: Use the same 25-person UK team at £39,000 with some experimentation, but licences and training both cost zero. What does ROI mean here?
positive.expected_behavior: Use both cost fields=0. Return positive modelled capacity value and null benefitCostRatio/netRoiPercent. Explain that the ratios are undefined with zero cost.

positive.description: Expensive training can reduce year-one net value.
positive.prompt: For 25 UK staff on £39,000, some using AI, licences at £20 a month and training at £5,000 per person, compare year-one net value.
positive.expected_behavior: Use trainingCostPerPersonGbp=5000. Report negative additionalYearOneNetValueGbp for training; do not recommend it based on gross value alone.

positive.description: Explain fixed methodology without requesting business or personal information.
positive.prompt: Which assumptions and formulas does the WCS AI ROI model use?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the 1.25 employer multiplier, 1700 annual hours, 46 weeks, adoption assumptions and source links. Distinguish scenario choices from measured outcomes and explain GBP/UK scope.

positive.description: French request, preserving GBP and the UK model.
positive.prompt: Comparez les scénarios pour 50 salariés au Royaume-Uni, salaire moyen de 40 000 livres, usage régulier dans une partie de l’équipe, licences à 20 livres par mois et formation à 300 livres par personne.
positive.expected_behavior: Use teamSize=50, annualSalaryGbp=40000, currentUsage=regular, monthlyToolCostGbp=20, trainingCostPerPersonGbp=300. Return the 55% and 79% assumed adoption rates and year-one costs of £12,000 and £27,000. Explain in French without converting currency.

negative.description: Outside geographic scope. Explain UK/GBP limitation. Do not invoke calculate_ai_roi with euro amounts presented as GBP.
negative.prompt: Calculate the ROI for my French team using salaries in euros and exact French employer contributions.

negative.description: Outside financial-product scope. Do not invoke either tool to forecast a stock return.
negative.prompt: How much will I earn if I invest £20,000 in AI stocks this year?

negative.description: Unsupported purchase action. Do not invoke calculation tools as if they book or buy training. Explain that the plugin has no booking or purchase capability.
negative.prompt: Book and pay for WCS training for my team next Tuesday.

review.commerce_description: This free calculator has no purchase, payment or booking function.

description: Estimate UK team AI adoption value in GBP using the WCS calculator. Compare adoption scenarios, costs and net ROI.
